layer6_toolbox.intro: 分析方法工具箱是前五层分析的补充，提供19种可复用的定量与结构化分析手法，按6个小类组织，帮助业务方快速定位适合当前问题的分析方法。每种方法按教材体展开：定义与别名、核心思想与原理、适用与不适用、分析目的、操作步骤、输出物与常见误区，并补充与其他方法的区别、边界条件与失效情形；另附业务问题与作品集应用示例。

methods.title: 帕累托分析
methods.desc: 按贡献度将分析对象从高到低排序，绘制累计占比曲线，识别少数关键项。通常约20%的对象贡献80%的结果，用于资源聚焦与优先级决策。
methods.bizQuestion: 哪些品牌、渠道或SKU对业绩贡献最大？应优先投入哪些对象？
methods.portfolio: 2026-06 品牌收入：跃动Pro 占净收入 52%，Pro+Life 合计 83%，验证二八；月度经营会将营销预算向 Pro 倾斜 15%，Life 维持、Go 控投。数据来自 dws_sales_daily → dws_sales_monthly。

methods.title: ABC 分类
methods.aliases: ABC 分析法 / 重点管理分类
methods.desc: 按价值贡献将管理对象划分为A（核心）、B（重要）、C（一般）三类，并配套差异化的监控频率、库存策略与审批权限。是帕累托分析在管理落地中的标准应用。
methods.bizQuestion: 在资源有限的情况下，哪些SKU或门店应重点监控，哪些可例行审视？
methods.portfolio: 品牌 ABC：A=跃动Pro/Life（日监控、优先补货），B=跃动Go（周复盘），C=配件（月审视、清仓优先）；A 类 SKU 占库存资金 68%。规则写在库存看板 v_inventory_monitor 的 alert_level。

methods.title: 波士顿矩阵
methods.aliases: BCG 矩阵 / 四象限分析 / 增长-份额矩阵
methods.desc: 以市场增长率和相对市场份额为两个维度，将业务单元划分至明星、金牛、问题、瘦狗四个象限，分别对应加大投入、维持收割、选择性培育与收缩退出等策略。
methods.bizQuestion: 各品牌与渠道组合应加大投入、维持运营还是收缩退出？
methods.portfolio: 品牌×渠道落点：抖音×Pro=明星（高增高份额，加投），天猫×Life=金牛（份额高增速放缓，稳现金流），线下×Go=瘦狗（坪效低于盈亏平衡，纳入关店评估）。见渠道分析看板与 P2 资源配置类路径。

methods.title: 根因分析
methods.desc: 从表面现象逐层追问原因，直至定位可执行的根本原因，而非停留在结果描述。常用方法包括5 Why、鱼骨图与假设验证树。
methods.bizQuestion: 毛利率下降的直接原因与根本原因分别是什么？涉及折扣、成本、结构还是退货？
methods.portfolio: Life 毛利率 52%→48%：品牌→渠道（抖音）→品类（鞋类）→根因大促折扣率 25%→42%，影响毛利约 -1,400 万。完整路径见 P2 第二层利润类 playbook，SQL 下钻 dwd_sales_wide + dim_channel。

methods.title: 归因分析
methods.aliases: 因素分解 / 贡献度分析 / Shapley 近似
methods.desc: 当结果由多个因素共同驱动时，量化各因素对变动的贡献度，例如收入变动中价格、销量、结构与退货的分别影响。可采用差额分解或回归系数等方法。
methods.bizQuestion: 本期收入变动中，销量、均价、退货与结构变化各贡献多少？
methods.portfolio: 2026-06 净收入环比 +2.1%（+220 万）分解：销量 +310 万、均价 -90 万、退货拖累 -40 万、结构变化 +40 万。写入月度经营会变动桥接附件，数据源 dws_sales_daily 的 revenue_mom_pct 与订单量拆解。

methods.title: 下钻分析
methods.aliases: 多维下钻 / OLAP Drill-down / 维度拆解
methods.desc: 从汇总指标出发，按时间、品牌、渠道、品类、SKU等维度逐层展开，定位异常所在的具体维度组合。是财务BP定位问题的基础方法。
methods.bizQuestion: 整体退货率偏高时，异常集中在哪些品牌、渠道与品类？
methods.portfolio: 退货率下钻：全公司 18% → 跃动Life 22% → 抖音 26% → 服装 31%。触发 P2 退货类路径，用 dws_sales_daily 按 brand_id/channel_id/category_id 聚合，再回 dwd_sales_wide 抽 200 单复核。

methods.title: 相关性分析
methods.aliases: 相关分析 / Pearson 相关 / 散点相关
methods.desc: 检验两个指标是否同向变动，以相关系数 r 衡量（-1 至 +1）。|r| 接近 1 表示关系较强，但相关不等于因果，需结合业务逻辑判断。
methods.bizQuestion: 广告投入与收入是否存在显著相关？库存天数与现金流的关系如何？
methods.portfolio: 2026-06 各渠道广告费 vs 净收入 r=0.87（强正相关）；但抖音 ROAS 从 3.0→2.1 时，优先查投放结构而非收入口径。散点图建在渠道分析看板，数据 ods_ad_cost + dws_sales_daily。

methods.title: 漏斗分析
methods.aliases: 转化漏斗 / AARRR 漏斗 / 步骤流失分析
methods.desc: 将业务过程的关键步骤绘制为漏斗，分析各步骤留存率与流失率，识别流失最显著的环节。零售场景常用于订单、支付、发货、签收与退货全流程。
methods.bizQuestion: 从下单到成交的哪个环节流失率最高？是引流质量、支付还是履约问题？
methods.portfolio: 订单履约漏斗（2026-06）：下单 12.8 万单 → 支付 12.1 万（94.5%）→ 发货 11.6 万（95.9%）→ 签收 11.2 万（96.6%）→ 无退货 9.8 万（87.5%）。签收→无退货环节流失最大，联动退货类下钻与客服质检报表。

methods.title: 同期群分析
methods.aliases: 队列分析 / Cohort Analysis / 分群留存
methods.desc: 按首次发生时间将用户或客户分组，跟踪各组在后续期间的复购、客单价与留存表现，用于评估获客质量变化。
methods.bizQuestion: 不同批次新客的复购与留存表现如何？哪类获客渠道留存更优？
methods.portfolio: 按首购月份分群：2025-11 新客 3 个月复购率 28%，2026-03 新客 3 个月复购率 35%，说明近期抖音内容种草质量提升。同期群表挂在会员运营附录，订单来源 dwd_sales_wide.customer_id + dim_date。

methods.title: 同比/环比增长率外推法
methods.aliases: 趋势外推 / 增长率法 / Run-rate
methods.desc: 基于最近一期的同比或环比增速，假设未来延续相同趋势，快速得到短期预测区间。适用于经营计划的初步估算，需明确标注假设条件。
methods.bizQuestion: 按当前增速，下季度能否完成目标？全年 run-rate 大致是多少？
methods.portfolio: 2026-06 净收入同比 +12.3%、环比 +2.1%；基准情景假设同比增速维持 → Q3 预测 2.7 亿（区间 2.5–2.9 亿）。写入 P2 第三层收入预测类产出物，对照 dws_sales_daily.revenue_yoy_pct。

methods.title: 移动平均法
methods.aliases: MA / Simple Moving Average / N 期均线
methods.desc: 取最近 N 期（如3个月）的算术平均值作为下一期预测，可平滑单月波动。N 越大曲线越平稳，但对拐点响应越慢。
methods.bizQuestion: 剔除大促波动后，近几个月的常态收入水平是多少？
methods.portfolio: 净收入 3 个月移动平均：2026-07 预测值 1.026 亿（基于 4–6 月均值），作为 Q3 经营会基准情景下限；与指数平滑结果交叉验证。

methods.title: 加权移动平均法
methods.desc: 在移动平均基础上为近期数据赋予更高权重（如3:2:1），兼顾噪声平滑与趋势响应，适用于短期动能明显的业务。
methods.bizQuestion: 近期回暖趋势能否在预测中更快体现，而不被前期淡季数据过度拉低？
methods.portfolio: 3 期加权 MA（权重 3:2:1）：2026-07 预测 1.029 亿，高于简单 MA 的 1.026 亿，反映 5–6 月回暖；用于乐观情景上限参考。

methods.title: 指数平滑法
methods.aliases: 指数加权移动平均 / EWMA / Holt 平滑
methods.desc: 对历史数据按指数递减赋权，近期观测权重更高，公式为 ŷₜ = α·yₜ + (1-α)·ŷₜ₋₁。α 越大对最新数据越敏感，越小则越平稳。
methods.bizQuestion: 如何在跟踪最新走势的同时，降低单月大促对预测的干扰？
methods.portfolio: 净收入指数平滑（α=0.3）：2026-07 预测 1.0175 亿，介于 MA 与 WMA 之间；α 敏感性见第六层敏感性分析。预测结果同步到现金流看板滚动 13 周。

methods.title: 季节性指数法
methods.aliases: 季节因子 / Seasonal Index / 旺淡季系数
methods.desc: 以各月均值除以全年月均得到12个月的季节性指数，大于1为旺季，小于1为淡季。预测时将趋势值乘以当月季节因子。
methods.bizQuestion: 春节淡季收入通常下降多少？大促月份应如何配置备货与预算？
methods.portfolio: 历史季节指数：11–12 月 1.25（双11/年货节），2 月 0.72（春节淡季）。2026-07 基准预测 1.02 亿 × 7 月指数 0.92 ≈ 0.94 亿。排产与营销预算按指数分配，见库存分析看板。

methods.title: 杜邦分析
methods.aliases: 杜邦恒等式 / ROE 拆解 / DuPont Analysis
methods.desc: 将净资产收益率 ROE 分解为净利率、资产周转率与权益乘数三个因子，用于识别 ROE 变动的主要驱动因素。
methods.bizQuestion: ROE 下降是净利率、资产周转还是杠杆变化所致？
methods.portfolio: 2026-06 杜邦：ROE 15.2% = 净利率 8.1% × 资产周转 1.42 × 权益乘数 1.32；同比下滑主因净利率 -1.2pct（Life 折扣）。见 v_dupont 与杜邦看板 shell.html#dupont。

methods.title: ROI 分析
methods.aliases: 投资回报率 / Return on Investment / ROAS（广告场景）
methods.desc: 衡量单位投入对应的回报水平，ROI =（收益 - 成本）/ 成本。营销场景常用 ROAS = 收入/广告费，用于评估渠道、活动与门店的投入价值。
methods.bizQuestion: 各渠道广告投入的回报水平如何？是否应调整投放规模？
methods.portfolio: 2026-06 渠道 ROI：天猫 3.5（行业基准 2.8，建议加投 10%），抖音 ROAS 2.1（从 3.0 下滑，暂停放量）、线下 8.2（自然流量为主）。结论写入 P2 第四层营销效果类。

methods.title: 盈亏平衡分析
methods.aliases: CVP 分析 / 本量利分析 / Break-even Analysis
methods.desc: 计算盈亏平衡点 = 固定成本 /（单价 - 单位变动成本），并评估安全边际，即当前收入相对保本点的距离。
methods.bizQuestion: 门店或业务单元达到盈亏平衡所需的收入规模是多少？促销对保本量的影响如何？
methods.portfolio: 线下 Go 店 CVP：月固定成本 45 万，毛利率 38%，保本收入 118 万/月；当前 92 万，安全边际 -22%。关店/缩租决策见 dws_sales_monthly + dws_expense_monthly（本量利推导） 与本量利看板 shell.html#cvp。

methods.title: 敏感性分析
methods.aliases: What-if 分析 / 情景分析 / 单因素敏感度
methods.desc: 在固定其他条件的前提下，单独改变一个变量（如折扣率、广告费、退货率），观察结果指标的变化幅度，识别对结果最敏感的杠杆因素。
methods.bizQuestion: 退货率、广告费或折扣率变动对利润的影响程度如何？
methods.portfolio: 敏感性矩阵（净利润）：退货率 +2pct → 利润 -680 万；广告费 -10% → 收入 -4.2%、利润 -320 万；折扣率 +5pct → 毛利 -1,100 万。退货最敏感，优先 P2 退货类根因。见预算执行 What-if 附件。

methods.title: 边际分析
methods.aliases: 边际贡献 / Marginal Analysis / 增量决策
methods.desc: 关注增量投入或增量销售带来的边际收益与边际成本，而非仅看平均水平。边际贡献为正时具备执行价值，直至边际收益等于边际成本。
methods.bizQuestion: 追加广告投入或新增门店的增量收益是否覆盖增量成本？
methods.portfolio: 边际投放：抖音减投 100 万（边际 ROAS 1.6 < 2.0 阈值）挪天猫（边际 ROAS 4.2），预计月利润 +180 万。写入 P2 第五层资源配置类建议，对照渠道边际 ROAS 曲线。

playbooks.title: 月度经营概况
playbooks.desc: 当月核心经营指标一览与环比同比
playbooks.bizQuestion: 这个月业绩怎么样？
triggers: 每月月初经营例会前需准备经营简报
管理层询问「上个月卖得怎么样」
需要向董事会/投资人汇报月度业绩

steps.title: 拉取当月核心经营指标
steps.desc: 从月度汇总视图获取 GMV、净收入、毛利、毛利率、退货率等核心指标，并与上月、去年同期对比。
steps.sql:
SELECT
    month, order_count, gmv, net_revenue, gross_profit, gross_margin_pct, return_rate_pct,
    LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue,
    ROUND((net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))
          / NULLIF(LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) * 100, 2) AS mom_revenue_pct
FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 3;
steps.judge: 净收入环比降幅超过 10% 或毛利率低于 35% 需标注关注
steps.output: 当月 KPI 卡片 + 近 3 个月趋势表

steps.title: 利润表视角验证收入与费用
steps.desc: 用损益视图交叉验证收入口径，并查看营业费用与净利润水平。
steps.sql:
SELECT snapshot_month, brand_name,
    SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit,
    SUM(operating_expense) AS operating_expense, SUM(net_profit) AS net_profit,
    ROUND(SUM(net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS net_margin_pct
FROM (SELECT s.snapshot_month, s.brand_name, s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit, SUM(IFNULL(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS operating_expense, SUM(s.profit) - SUM(IFNULL(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS net_profit FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly s LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e ON s.snapshot_month = e.snapshot_month AND s.brand_name = e.brand_name AND s.channel_name = e.channel_name GROUP BY s.snapshot_month, s.brand_name, s.channel_name) v_income_statement
WHERE snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY snapshot_month, brand_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
steps.judge: 各品牌收入合计应与 dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总） 净收入基本一致（±2%）

steps.title: 杜邦分析看 ROE 驱动因素
steps.desc: 从杜邦分解判断当月盈利能力变化的主因是利润率、周转还是杠杆。
steps.sql:
SELECT snapshot_month, brand_name, net_profit_margin, asset_turnover, equity_multiplier, roe,
    roe_change_vs_last_month, roe_drag_factor
FROM retail_finance.v_dupont
WHERE snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY roe DESC;
steps.judge: roe_drag_factor 非「无拖累项」的品牌需列入月度简报重点说明
steps.output: ROE 驱动因素说明段落

steps.title: 现金流与利润匹配度
steps.desc: 检查经营现金流与净利润的匹配关系，避免「有利润无现金」。
steps.sql:
SELECT snapshot_month, brand_name, operating_cashflow, net_profit, profit_to_cash_ratio
FROM retail_finance.v_cashflow
WHERE snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY profit_to_cash_ratio ASC;
steps.judge: 净现比 < 0.8 需在月报中单独提示资金压力

outputs: 月度经营概况一页纸（KPI + 趋势 + 品牌贡献）
管理层月报 PPT 数据底稿
nextSteps: 若收入/毛利异常 → 进入「收入下滑诊断」或「毛利率下滑诊断」
若费用率偏高 → 进入「费用率异常诊断」
若现金流紧张 → 进入「资金缺口预测」

playbooks.title: 年度累计经营概况
playbooks.desc: 年初至今累计业绩与年度预算进度
playbooks.bizQuestion: 今年到目前为止怎么样了？
triggers: 季度/半年度经营复盘会议
年中需评估年度目标可达性
投资人关心全年业绩指引

steps.title: 计算 YTD 核心指标
steps.desc: 汇总年初至今的 GMV、净收入、毛利及同比增速。
steps.sql:
SELECT YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(month, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')) AS yr,
    SUM(order_count) AS ytd_orders, SUM(gmv) AS ytd_gmv, SUM(revenue) AS ytd_revenue,
    SUM(profit) AS ytd_gross_profit,
    ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS ytd_gross_margin_pct
FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01-01')), '%Y-%m')
  AND month <= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(month, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'));
steps.judge: YTD 收入增速低于 5% 且已过年中 → 触发目标预警
steps.output: YTD 核心 KPI 汇总行

steps.title: 对比年度预算执行进度
steps.desc: 从预算执行表查看各费用科目累计执行情况。
steps.sql:
SELECT b.expense_type, SUM(b.budget_amount) AS ytd_budget, SUM(b.expense_amount) AS ytd_actual,
    ROUND(SUM(b.expense_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(b.budget_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS budget_usage_pct,
    SUM(b.variance_amount) AS ytd_variance
FROM retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly b
INNER JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly b ON 1=1
WHERE b.snapshot_month >= CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01')
  AND b.snapshot_month <= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY b.expense_type ORDER BY ytd_variance ASC;
steps.judge: 费用执行率 > 110% 的科目需列入 YTD 风险提示

steps.title: YTD 净利润与 ROE 走势
steps.desc: 从杜邦视图看累计盈利能力变化趋势。
steps.judge: 连续 3 个月 ROE 下降 → 建议启动盈利诊断
steps.output: YTD ROE 趋势折线图数据

steps.title: 资产负债表年末预期
steps.desc: 查看最新月末资产、负债、权益结构，评估全年财务健康度。
steps.sql:
SELECT snapshot_month, brand_name, total_assets, inventory, debt, equity,
    ROUND(debt / NULLIF(total_assets, 0) * 100, 2) AS debt_ratio_pct
FROM (

    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%%Y-%%m') AS snapshot_month,
        i.brand_name,
        SUM(i.stock_amount) AS inventory,
        0 AS debt,
        SUM(i.stock_amount) AS total_assets,
        SUM(i.stock_amount) AS equity
    FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily i
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%%Y-%%m'), i.brand_name
) bs
WHERE snapshot_month = (SELECT MAX(month_id) FROM (
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%%Y-%%m') AS snapshot_month,
        i.brand_name,
        SUM(i.stock_amount) AS inventory,
        0 AS debt,
        SUM(i.stock_amount) AS total_assets,
        SUM(i.stock_amount) AS equity
    FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily i
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%%Y-%%m'), i.brand_name) bs WHERE snapshot_month >= CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01'))
ORDER BY total_assets DESC;
steps.judge: 资产负债率 > 60% 需在 YTD 报告中提示偿债风险

outputs: 年度累计经营概况报告
YTD vs 预算差异分析表
nextSteps: 预算缺口大 → 「年底目标达成预测」
盈利走弱 → 「净利润下滑诊断」
资产结构恶化 → 「资金缺口预测」

playbooks.title: 单日经营简报
playbooks.desc: 当日/昨日销售与现金流速览
playbooks.bizQuestion: 昨天卖了多少？
triggers: 每日晨会前需快速了解昨日业绩

steps.title: 昨日销售核心指标
steps.desc: 从销售日汇总表获取昨日 GMV、净收入、订单量、退货。
steps.sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0, SUM(s.gmv) AS daily_gmv, SUM(s.revenue) AS daily_revenue,
    SUM(s.order_count) AS daily_orders, SUM(s.return_amount) AS daily_returns,
    ROUND(SUM(s.return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(s.gmv), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct,
    SUM(s.profit) AS daily_gross_profit
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0;
steps.judge: 日收入较前 7 日均值波动 > 20% 需标注异常

steps.title: 对比近 7 日/30 日均值
steps.desc: 判断昨日表现是否偏离正常区间。
steps.sql:
WITH daily AS (
    SELECT snapshot_date AS date_id, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 31 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
                      AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
    GROUP BY snapshot_date)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_date = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0 THEN revenue END) AS yesterday,
    ROUND(AVG(revenue), 2) AS avg_30d,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0 THEN revenue END), 2) AS avg_7d
FROM daily;
steps.judge: 昨日 < 7 日均值 80% → 触发渠道/品牌日度下钻

steps.title: 昨日渠道贡献分布
steps.desc: 快速识别哪个渠道拉动或拖累昨日业绩。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.order_count) AS orders,
    ROUND(SUM(s.revenue) / SUM(SUM(s.revenue)) OVER () * 100, 2) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s

WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY s.channel_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
steps.judge: 单一渠道收入占比突变 > 5ppt → 需排查活动或系统问题

steps.title: 昨日现金流进出
steps.desc: 同步查看昨日现金流入流出，评估当日资金状况。
steps.sql:
SELECT snapshot_date AS date_id, SUM(inflow_amount) AS inflow, SUM(outflow_amount) AS outflow, SUM(net_cashflow) AS net_cashflow
FROM (SELECT payment_date AS snapshot_date, SUM(payment_amount) AS inflow_amount, 0 AS outflow_amount, SUM(payment_amount) AS net_cashflow FROM retail_finance.ods_payment GROUP BY payment_date) cf
WHERE snapshot_date = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY snapshot_date;
steps.judge: 净流出连续 3 天 → 提示资金关注

outputs: 异常渠道/品牌当日提示
nextSteps: 日度大幅下滑 → 「收入下滑诊断」按日粒度下钻
大促日 → 「促销活动效果评估」
现金流异常 → 「净现比下降诊断」

playbooks.title: 各品牌表现排名
playbooks.desc: 品牌维度收入毛利与增速排名
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪个品牌卖得好？哪个品牌在掉队？
triggers: 需决定资源向哪个品牌倾斜
某品牌负责人询问相对排名

steps.title: 当月品牌收入毛利排名
steps.desc: 按品牌汇总当月净收入、毛利、毛利率并排名。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.brand_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit,
    ROUND(SUM(s.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s

WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AND s.brand_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.brand_name ORDER BY revenue_rank;
steps.judge: 收入排名前 3 品牌贡献应 > 70% 总收入

steps.title: 品牌环比增速排名
steps.desc: 对比上月，识别增长最快与下滑最严重的品牌。
steps.sql:
WITH brand_m AS (
    SELECT s.brand_name, DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') AS snapshot_month, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
    FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
    WHERE s.brand_name IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') IN (
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m'),
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m'))
    GROUP BY s.brand_name, DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m'))
SELECT cur.brand_name, cur.revenue AS cur_revenue, prev.revenue AS prev_revenue,
    ROUND((cur.revenue - prev.revenue) / NULLIF(prev.revenue, 0) * 100, 2) AS mom_pct
FROM brand_m cur LEFT JOIN brand_m prev ON cur.brand_name = prev.brand_name
    AND prev.snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
WHERE cur.snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY mom_pct DESC;
steps.judge: 环比降幅 > 15% 的品牌列入重点关注

steps.title: 品牌杜邦 ROE 对比
steps.desc: 从盈利能力角度补充品牌综合表现评价。
steps.judge: 高收入低 ROE 品牌需分析费用与资产效率
steps.output: 品牌综合评分矩阵数据

outputs: 品牌表现排名榜（收入/毛利/增速）
落后品牌改进建议清单
nextSteps: 某品牌大幅下滑 → 「收入下滑诊断」按品牌下钻
某品牌毛利偏低 → 「毛利率下滑诊断」
资源倾斜决策 → 「预算分配优化」

playbooks.title: 各渠道表现排名
playbooks.desc: 线上线下渠道收入费用与 ROI 排名
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪个渠道最赚钱？哪个渠道在烧钱？
triggers: 渠道策略调整前需数据支撑
平台佣金上涨需评估渠道盈亏

steps.title: 渠道收入与毛利排名
steps.desc: 汇总各渠道当月净收入、毛利、订单量。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit,
    SUM(s.order_count) AS orders,
    ROUND(SUM(s.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY s.channel_name ORDER BY revenue_rank;
steps.judge: 收入第一渠道占比超 50% 需关注集中度风险

steps.title: 渠道费用率对比
steps.desc: 结合费用月汇总，计算各渠道费用占收入比。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, IFNULL(SUM(e.expense_amount), 0) AS channel_expense,
    ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(e.expense_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS expense_rate_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e ON DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = e.snapshot_month AND s.channel_name = e.channel_name
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY s.channel_name ORDER BY expense_rate_pct DESC;
steps.judge: 费用率 > 25% 且毛利 < 40% 的渠道为亏损风险渠道

steps.title: 渠道广告投入与产出
steps.desc: 关联广告费用 ODS，估算渠道投放 ROI。
steps.sql:
SELECT a.channel_name, SUM(a.ad_spend) AS ad_spend, SUM(s.revenue) AS attributed_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(s.revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(a.ad_spend), 0), 2) AS revenue_per_ad_yuan
FROM retail_finance.ods_ad_cost a
LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s ON a.channel_name = (
    SELECT channel_name FROM retail_finance.dim_channel WHERE channel_id = s.channel_id LIMIT 1)
    AND DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 = DATE_FORMAT(a.ad_date, '%Y%m%d') + 0
WHERE a.ad_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
GROUP BY a.channel_name ORDER BY revenue_per_ad_yuan DESC;
steps.judge: 广告产出 < 3 元/元投入 → 建议缩减投放

outputs: 低效渠道关停/优化建议
nextSteps: 渠道 ROI 低 → 「渠道投入产出评估」
费用率异常 → 「费用率异常诊断」
持续下降 → 「渠道ROI持续下降预警」

playbooks.title: 各品类表现排名
playbooks.desc: 鞋服配等品类销售结构与毛利排名
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪个品类是现金牛？哪个品类在拖累？
triggers: 订货会前需品类结构分析
清仓季需识别滞销品类

steps.title: 品类收入毛利排名
steps.desc: 按品类汇总收入、毛利、占比。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit,
    ROUND(SUM(s.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(s.revenue) / SUM(SUM(s.revenue)) OVER () * 100, 2) AS revenue_share_pct,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY i.category_name ORDER BY revenue_rank;
steps.judge: 收入占比与毛利贡献不匹配（高收入低毛利）的品类需标注

steps.title: 品类退货率对比
steps.desc: 识别退货率异常的品类。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name, SUM(s.return_amount) AS return_amount, SUM(s.gmv) AS gmv,
    ROUND(SUM(s.return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(s.gmv), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY i.category_name ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC;
steps.judge: 退货率 > 15% → 触发「退货率异常诊断」

steps.title: 品类库存周转对比
steps.desc: 结合库存日汇总看各品类周转天数。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name, ROUND(AVG(i.turnover_days), 1) AS avg_turnover_days, SUM(i.stock_amount) AS stock_amount
FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily i 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily)
GROUP BY i.category_name ORDER BY avg_turnover_days DESC;
steps.judge: 周转天数 > 90 天且收入下滑的品类优先清仓

nextSteps: 滞销高库存 → 「库存清仓优化」
退货率高 → 「退货率异常诊断」
品类预测 → 「下季度品牌/品类收入预测」

playbooks.title: 各门店表现排名
playbooks.desc: 门店坪效、利润与区域排名
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪家店是标杆？哪家店该关？
triggers: 新店选址与老店调整决策

steps.title: 门店日收入排名（近30日）
steps.desc: 汇总近 30 日各门店收入与利润。
steps.sql:
SELECT store_id, store_name, region, SUM(daily_revenue) AS revenue_30d, SUM(daily_profit) AS profit_30d,
    ROUND(SUM(daily_revenue) / NULLIF(MAX(store_area), 0), 2) AS pingxiao,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(daily_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM retail_finance.dws_store_daily
WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY store_id, store_name, region ORDER BY revenue_rank;
steps.judge: 后 10% 门店收入 < 前 10% 门店 30% → 关注关停

steps.title: 门店 vs 7日/30日均值偏离
steps.desc: 利用预计算的近 7/30 日均识别异常门店。
steps.sql:
SELECT store_name, region, revenue AS daily_revenue, revenue, pingsiao,
    ROUND((daily_revenue - avg_daily_revenue_30d) / NULLIF(avg_daily_revenue_30d, 0) * 100, 2) AS vs_30d_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_store_daily
WHERE snapshot_date = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY vs_30d_pct ASC LIMIT 20;
steps.judge: 连续 7 日低于 30 日均值 70% → 列入预警

steps.title: 区域门店密度与坪效
steps.desc: 按区域聚合，评估区域经营效率。
steps.sql:
SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS store_count, SUM(daily_revenue) AS region_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(daily_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(store_area), 0), 2) AS region_pingxiao
FROM retail_finance.dws_store_daily
WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY region ORDER BY region_pingxiao DESC;
steps.judge: 坪效低于区域均值 50% 的门店需个案分析

nextSteps: 持续亏损门店 → 「门店关停评估」
区域整体下滑 → 「收入下滑诊断」按区域下钻
标杆店经验 → 营销/陈列最佳实践复制

playbooks.title: 毛利率下滑诊断
playbooks.desc: 定位毛利率下降是成本、定价还是结构问题
playbooks.bizQuestion: 毛利率为什么下降了？
triggers: 某品牌/品类毛利明显低于历史均值
竞品降价后我方毛利承压

steps.title: 确认整体毛利率变化幅度
steps.desc: 对比近 3 个月毛利率走势，量化下滑幅度。
steps.sql:
SELECT month, gross_margin_pct, gross_profit, net_revenue,
    LAG(gross_margin_pct) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_margin,
    ROUND(gross_margin_pct - LAG(gross_margin_pct) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS margin_change_ppt
FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month DESC;
steps.judge: 连续 2 月毛利率下降且累计 > 3ppt → 启动品牌/品类下钻

steps.title: 按品牌拆解毛利率贡献
steps.desc: 识别哪个品牌拉低整体毛利率。
steps.sql:
SELECT brand_name, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit,
    ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM (SELECT s.snapshot_month, s.brand_name, s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit, SUM(IFNULL(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS operating_expense, SUM(s.profit) - SUM(IFNULL(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS net_profit FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly s LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e ON s.snapshot_month = e.snapshot_month AND s.brand_name = e.brand_name AND s.channel_name = e.channel_name GROUP BY s.snapshot_month, s.brand_name, s.channel_name) v_income_statement
WHERE snapshot_month IN (DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m'),
                   DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m'))
GROUP BY brand_name, snapshot_month ORDER BY brand_name, snapshot_month DESC;
steps.judge: 某品牌毛利率单月下降 > 5ppt 需优先排查采购价与促销折扣

steps.title: 按品类拆解毛利率
steps.desc: 分析品类结构变化对整体毛利率的影响。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name, SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(s.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(s.revenue) / SUM(SUM(s.revenue)) OVER () * 100, 2) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY i.category_name ORDER BY revenue_share_pct DESC;
steps.judge: 低毛利品类收入占比上升 > 3ppt → 结构恶化是主因

steps.title: 成本与退货对毛利侵蚀
steps.desc: 检查退货率上升与采购成本变动。
steps.sql:
SELECT month, return_rate_pct, gross_margin_pct FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;
steps.judge: 退货率与毛利率同步恶化 → 优先查品控与尺码/描述问题

criteria.dim: 低毛利品类收入占比变化

outputs: 改进措施清单（调价/控促/换供）

促销过度 → 「折扣策略优化」
结构问题 → 「定价优化分析」

playbooks.title: 净利润下滑诊断
playbooks.desc: 从收入、毛利、费用三端定位净利润下降原因
playbooks.bizQuestion: 净利润为什么少了？
triggers: 净利润环比/同比显著下降
有收入增但利润减的「增收不增利」现象

steps.title: 确认净利润变化与利润率
steps.desc: 从损益视图获取各品牌净利润及净利率变化。
steps.sql:
SELECT brand_name, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(net_profit) AS net_profit,
    ROUND(SUM(net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS net_margin_pct
FROM (SELECT s.snapshot_month, s.brand_name, s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit, SUM(IFNULL(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS operating_expense, SUM(s.profit) - SUM(IFNULL(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS net_profit FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly s LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e ON s.snapshot_month = e.snapshot_month AND s.brand_name = e.brand_name AND s.channel_name = e.channel_name GROUP BY s.snapshot_month, s.brand_name, s.channel_name) v_income_statement
WHERE snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY brand_name ORDER BY net_profit ASC;
steps.judge: 整体净利率 < 5% 或环比下降 > 2ppt → 需分端拆解

steps.title: 杜邦分解：利润率 vs 周转 vs 杠杆
steps.desc: 判断净利润下降是盈利效率还是资产周转问题。
steps.judge: roe_drag_factor 指向「净利率」→ 优先查费用与毛利

steps.title: 费用端拆解
steps.desc: 按费用类型查看超预算与费用率异常科目。
steps.sql:
SELECT b.expense_type, SUM(b.expense_amount) AS actual, SUM(b.budget_amount) AS budget,
    ROUND(SUM(b.expense_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(b.budget_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS usage_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly b
INNER JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly b ON 1=1
WHERE b.snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY b.expense_type ORDER BY usage_pct DESC;
steps.judge: 营销/平台费用超预算 20% 以上 → 关联渠道 ROI 评估

steps.title: 收入与毛利端交叉验证
steps.desc: 排除「费用正常但毛利/收入拖累」的情况。
steps.sql:
SELECT month, net_revenue, gross_profit, gross_margin_pct FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC;
steps.judge: 收入稳但毛利降 → 转「毛利率下滑诊断」
steps.output: 收入-毛利-利润瀑布图数据

outputs: 费用/收入/毛利三端贡献表
