playbooks.title: 收入下滑诊断
playbooks.desc: 五层下钻定位收入下降根因：整体→品牌→渠道→品类→量价
playbooks.bizQuestion: 收入为什么下降了？主要拖累来自哪里？
triggers: 月度经营概况触发收入预警
某核心品牌或渠道收入断崖式下跌

steps.title: 确认整体收入下滑幅度
steps.desc: 量化当月相对上月、去年同期的收入变化，确认下滑是否真实且显著。
steps.sql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT month, net_revenue, order_count,
        LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue,
        LAG(net_revenue, 12) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS yoy_revenue
    FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
    WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 15 MONTH), '%Y-%m'))
SELECT month, net_revenue, prev_revenue, yoy_revenue,
    ROUND((net_revenue - prev_revenue) / NULLIF(prev_revenue, 0) * 100, 2) AS mom_pct,
    ROUND((net_revenue - yoy_revenue) / NULLIF(yoy_revenue, 0) * 100, 2) AS yoy_pct
FROM m WHERE month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m');
steps.judge: 环比与同比均为负且 |mom_pct| > 10% → 进入维度拆解
steps.output: 整体收入变化摘要（环比/同比/绝对额）

steps.title: 按品牌拆解贡献
steps.desc: 计算各品牌收入增减额及对整体下滑的贡献度，锁定首要拖累品牌。
steps.sql:
WITH brand_m AS (
    SELECT s.brand_name, DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') AS snapshot_month,
        SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
    FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s
    
    WHERE s.brand_name IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') IN (
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m'),
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m'))
    GROUP BY s.brand_name, DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m')),
total AS (
    SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN revenue END) -
           SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN revenue END) AS total_delta
    FROM brand_m)
SELECT cur.brand_name, cur.revenue AS cur_revenue, prev.revenue AS prev_revenue,
    cur.revenue - prev.revenue AS revenue_delta,
    ROUND((cur.revenue - prev.revenue) / NULLIF(total.total_delta, 0) * 100, 2) AS contribution_pct,
    ROUND((cur.revenue - prev.revenue) / NULLIF(prev.revenue, 0) * 100, 2) AS brand_mom_pct
FROM brand_m cur
INNER JOIN brand_m prev ON cur.brand_name = prev.brand_name
    AND prev.snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
CROSS JOIN total
WHERE cur.snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY revenue_delta ASC;
steps.judge: 贡献度 > 30% 的下滑品牌列为 P0 排查对象

steps.title: 按渠道拆解
steps.desc: 在问题品牌或全量范围内，识别哪个渠道收入流失最多。
steps.sql:
WITH ch_m AS (
    SELECT s.channel_name, DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') AS snapshot_month, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
    FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s
    
    WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') IN (
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m'),
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m'))
    GROUP BY s.channel_name, DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m'))
SELECT cur.channel_name, cur.revenue AS cur_revenue, prev.revenue AS prev_revenue,
    cur.revenue - prev.revenue AS revenue_delta,
    ROUND((cur.revenue - prev.revenue) / NULLIF(prev.revenue, 0) * 100, 2) AS channel_mom_pct
FROM ch_m cur
INNER JOIN ch_m prev ON cur.channel_name = prev.channel_name
    AND prev.snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
WHERE cur.snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY revenue_delta ASC;
steps.judge: 线上平台渠道大幅下滑 → 查流量/投放/平台政策；线下 → 查客流与竞品

steps.title: 按品类拆解
steps.desc: 在已识别的问题品牌/渠道内，进一步按品类定位结构性拖累。
steps.sql:
WITH cat_m AS (
    SELECT i.category_name, DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') AS snapshot_month, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
    FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s
    
    WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') IN (
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m'),
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m'))
    GROUP BY i.category_name, DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m'))
SELECT cur.category_name, cur.revenue AS cur_revenue, prev.revenue AS prev_revenue,
    cur.revenue - prev.revenue AS revenue_delta,
    ROUND((cur.revenue - prev.revenue) / NULLIF(prev.revenue, 0) * 100, 2) AS category_mom_pct
FROM cat_m cur
INNER JOIN cat_m prev ON cur.category_name = prev.category_name
    AND prev.snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
WHERE cur.snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY revenue_delta ASC;
steps.judge: 单一品类贡献下滑 > 40% → 查库存、上新与竞品替代

steps.title: 订单量 vs 客单价拆解
steps.desc: 将收入变动分解为订单量变化与客单价（AOV）变化，判断是「卖得少」还是「买得便宜」。
steps.sql:
WITH cur AS (
    SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(order_count) AS orders,
        ROUND(SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(order_count), 0), 2) AS aov
    FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily
    WHERE DATE_FORMAT(snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')),
prev AS (
    SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(order_count) AS orders,
        ROUND(SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(order_count), 0), 2) AS aov
    FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily
    WHERE DATE_FORMAT(snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y-%m'))
SELECT cur.revenue AS cur_revenue, prev.revenue AS prev_revenue,
    cur.orders AS cur_orders, prev.orders AS prev_orders,
    cur.aov AS cur_aov, prev.aov AS prev_aov,
    ROUND((cur.orders - prev.orders) / NULLIF(prev.orders, 0) * 100, 2) AS order_mom_pct,
    ROUND((cur.aov - prev.aov) / NULLIF(prev.aov, 0) * 100, 2) AS aov_mom_pct,
    ROUND(prev.orders * (cur.aov - prev.aov), 2) AS aov_effect,
    ROUND((cur.orders - prev.orders) * prev.aov, 2) AS volume_effect
FROM cur, prev;
steps.judge: 订单量降 > 10% 且 AOV 稳 → 流量/转化问题；AOV 降 > 10% → 折扣/结构问题

outputs: 收入下滑五层下钻报告
品牌-渠道-品类贡献瀑布图
量价分解结论与行动清单
nextSteps: 流量/订单问题 → 「渠道投入产出评估」
折扣/AOV 问题 → 「折扣策略优化」
品类滞销 → 「库存清仓优化」

playbooks.title: 收入增长缓慢诊断
playbooks.desc: 收入正增长但低于预期时的瓶颈分析
playbooks.bizQuestion: 收入增长为什么这么慢？
triggers: 收入增速 < 行业/预算目标
YTD 达成率落后时间进度

steps.title: 量化增速与目标差距
steps.desc: 对比近 6 个月收入增速与年度预算进度。
steps.sql:
SELECT month, net_revenue,
    ROUND((net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))
          / NULLIF(LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) * 100, 2) AS mom_pct
FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 MONTH), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;
steps.judge: 近 3 月平均环比 < 3% → 进入维度瓶颈分析

steps.title: 品牌/渠道增长矩阵
steps.desc: 识别高增长与停滞维度。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.brand_name, s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s


WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY s.brand_name, s.channel_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 30;
steps.judge: 主力品牌-渠道组合零增长 → 优先投入或替代方案

steps.title: 订单与新客结构
steps.desc: 从订单事实表看客单与复购结构。
steps.sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers,
    ROUND(SUM(payment_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0), 2) AS aov
FROM retail_finance.dwd_sales_wide
WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND return_flag = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;
steps.judge: 客数增但客单降 → 拉新有效但变现弱

steps.title: 费用投入与增长匹配度
steps.desc: 检查营销费用增速是否高于收入增速。
steps.sql:
SELECT SUM(b.expense_amount) AS marketing_spend
FROM retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly b
INNER JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly b ON 1=1
WHERE b.expense_type LIKE '%营销%' AND b.snapshot_month >= CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01');
steps.judge: 营销费增速 > 收入增速 2 倍 → 投放效率待优化

nextSteps: 投放效率低 → 「营销费用优化」
渠道停滞 → 「渠道投入产出评估」
目标风险 → 「年底目标达成预测」

playbooks.title: 退货率异常诊断
playbooks.desc: 定位退货率飙升的品类、渠道与 SKU 根因
playbooks.bizQuestion: 退货率为什么突然升高？
triggers: 整体退货率 > 12% 或环比升 > 3ppt
某品类/渠道退货率异常

steps.title: 确认整体退货率走势
steps.desc: 从月度汇总视图查看退货率变化。
steps.sql:
SELECT month, return_rate_pct, return_amount, gmv FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;
steps.judge: 单月退货率 > 15% 或连升 2 月 → 下钻

steps.title: 品类/渠道退货率拆解
steps.desc: 定位高退货品类与渠道。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name, s.channel_name,
    SUM(s.return_amount) AS return_amt, SUM(s.gmv) AS gmv,
    ROUND(SUM(s.return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(s.gmv), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s


WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY i.category_name, s.channel_name ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 20;
steps.judge: 鞋类线上渠道退货率 > 20% → 重点查尺码与描述

steps.title: 退货订单明细追溯
steps.desc: 从 ODS 退货表查退款原因分布。
steps.sql:
SELECT refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS refund_cnt, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amt
FROM retail_finance.ods_orders（return_flag=1）
WHERE refund_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY refund_reason ORDER BY refund_cnt DESC;
steps.judge: 「尺码不合」「与描述不符」占比 > 50% → 商品端整改

steps.title: 退货对毛利与现金的影响
steps.desc: 量化退货对毛利和现金流的侵蚀。
steps.judge: 退货额 > 毛利 15% → 列入经营例会重点

nextSteps: 商品描述/尺码 → 供应链与商品部协同
恶意退货 → 风控规则优化
毛利侵蚀 → 「毛利率下滑诊断」

playbooks.title: 费用率异常诊断
playbooks.desc: 识别费用率超标科目与渠道
playbooks.bizQuestion: 费用率为什么高了？哪个科目超支？
triggers: 某渠道/品牌费用率环比上升

steps.title: 整体费用率趋势
steps.desc: 结合月度收入与费用汇总计算费用率。
steps.sql:
SELECT e.snapshot_month, SUM(e.expense_amount) AS total_expense,
    (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总） ms
     WHERE REPLACE(ms.month, '-', '') = CAST(e.snapshot_month AS CHAR)) AS revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(e.expense_amount) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总） ms
     WHERE REPLACE(ms.month, '-', '') = CAST(e.snapshot_month AS CHAR)), 0) * 100, 2) AS expense_rate_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e
WHERE e.snapshot_month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY e.snapshot_month ORDER BY e.snapshot_month;
steps.judge: 费用率连续 2 月上升且 > 28% → 下钻科目

steps.title: 费用科目预算执行
steps.desc: 从预算执行表看超支科目。
steps.sql:
SELECT b.expense_type, b.budget_amount, b.expense_amount, b.variance_amount,
    ROUND(b.expense_amount / NULLIF(b.budget_amount, 0) * 100, 2) AS usage_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly b
INNER JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly b ON 1=1
WHERE b.snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY b.variance_amount ASC;
steps.judge: 营销/平台佣金超预算 → 关联渠道 ROI

steps.title: 渠道维度费用率
steps.desc: 各渠道费用占收入比。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(e.expense_amount) AS expense,
    ROUND(SUM(e.expense_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS expense_rate_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s

LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e ON s.channel_name = e.channel_name
    AND DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = e.snapshot_month
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY s.channel_name ORDER BY expense_rate_pct DESC;
steps.judge: 费用率 > 30% 且 ROI < 3 → 建议减投

steps.title: 广告费与收入匹配
steps.desc: ODS 广告费对比渠道收入产出。
steps.sql:
SELECT channel_name, SUM(ad_spend) AS ad_spend FROM retail_finance.ods_ad_cost
WHERE ad_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY channel_name;
steps.judge: 广告费/渠道收入 > 15% → 投放效率预警

nextSteps: 营销超支 → 「营销费用优化」
渠道低效 → 「渠道投入产出评估」
侵蚀利润 → 「净利润下滑诊断」

playbooks.title: 净现比下降诊断
playbooks.desc: 分析经营现金流与净利润背离原因
playbooks.bizQuestion: 为什么有利润但现金紧张？净现比为什么下降？

steps.title: 确认净现比水平与趋势
steps.desc: 从现金流量表视图查看各品牌净现比。
steps.sql:
SELECT snapshot_month, brand_name, operating_cashflow, net_profit, profit_to_cash_ratio
FROM retail_finance.v_cashflow
WHERE snapshot_month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY snapshot_month DESC, profit_to_cash_ratio ASC;
steps.judge: 净现比 < 0.7 连续 2 月 → 深入营运资本

steps.title: 日度现金流波动
steps.desc: 从日度现金流表看近期进出结构。
steps.sql:
SELECT snapshot_date AS date_id, SUM(inflow_amount) AS inflow, SUM(outflow_amount) AS outflow,
    SUM(net_cashflow) AS net_cf
FROM (SELECT payment_date AS snapshot_date, SUM(payment_amount) AS inflow_amount, 0 AS outflow_amount, SUM(payment_amount) AS net_cashflow FROM retail_finance.ods_payment GROUP BY payment_date) cf
WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY snapshot_date;
steps.judge: 连续 5 日净流出 → 触发资金预警

steps.title: 库存占用对现金的挤压
steps.desc: 库存余额与周转变化是否占用过多现金。
steps.sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0, SUM(i.stock_amount) AS stock_amount, AVG(i.turnover_days) AS avg_turnover
FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily i
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 DESC LIMIT 10;
steps.judge: 库存成本升且周转天数升 → 库存占现金主因

steps.title: 资产负债表验证
steps.desc: 查看应收、库存、负债结构变化。
steps.sql:
SELECT snapshot_month, brand_name, inventory, debt, total_assets,
    ROUND(inventory / NULLIF(total_assets, 0) * 100, 2) AS inventory_pct
FROM (

    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%%Y-%%m') AS snapshot_month,
        i.brand_name,
        SUM(i.stock_amount) AS inventory,
        0 AS debt,
        SUM(i.stock_amount) AS total_assets,
        SUM(i.stock_amount) AS equity
    FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily i
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%%Y-%%m'), i.brand_name
) bs
WHERE snapshot_month = (SELECT MAX(month_id) FROM (
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%%Y-%%m') AS snapshot_month,
        i.brand_name,
        SUM(i.stock_amount) AS inventory,
        0 AS debt,
        SUM(i.stock_amount) AS total_assets,
        SUM(i.stock_amount) AS equity
    FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily i
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%%Y-%%m'), i.brand_name) bs)
ORDER BY inventory_pct DESC;
steps.judge: 库存占资产 > 40% → 优先去库存

outputs: 现金流-库存-应收联动分析
nextSteps: 库存积压 → 「库存清仓优化」
未来缺口 → 「资金缺口预测」
周转慢 → 「库存周转天数上升诊断」

playbooks.title: 库存周转天数上升诊断
playbooks.desc: 定位库存周转变慢的品牌、品类与仓店
playbooks.bizQuestion: 库存为什么越压越多、周转越来越慢？
triggers: 周转天数环比升 > 10 天
库存成本占资产比上升
清仓季前库存压力预警

steps.title: 整体周转天数趋势
steps.desc: 从库存日汇总看近 90 天周转天数走势。
steps.sql:
SELECT snapshot_date AS date_id, AVG(turnover_days) AS avg_turnover, SUM(stock_amount) AS total_inv
FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily
WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY snapshot_date;
steps.judge: 周转天数 90 日内上升趋势明显 → 下钻品类

steps.title: 品类库存结构
steps.desc: 哪些品类库存成本高、周转慢。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name, SUM(i.stock_amount) AS inv_cost,
    ROUND(AVG(i.turnover_days), 1) AS avg_turnover
FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily i

WHERE DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily)
GROUP BY i.category_name ORDER BY avg_turnover DESC;
steps.judge: 周转 > 90 天且库存成本 TOP3 品类 → 清仓优先

steps.title: 销售与库存匹配度
steps.desc: 对比品类近 30 日销售增速与库存增速。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue_30d
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s

WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY i.category_name ORDER BY revenue_30d ASC LIMIT 15;
steps.judge: 销售降且库存升 → 典型滞销信号

steps.title: 采购入库节奏
steps.desc: 从采购 ODS 看是否过量进货。
steps.sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(receipt_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    SUM(receipt_amount) AS receipt_amt, COUNT(*) AS receipt_cnt
FROM retail_finance.ods_purchase_receipt
WHERE receipt_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(receipt_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;
steps.judge: 入库额升而销售降 → 采购节奏需调整

nextSteps: 滞销处理 → 「库存清仓优化」
现金压力 → 「净现比下降诊断」
减少进货 → 「供应商绩效评估」

playbooks.title: 下月收入预测
playbooks.desc: 基于历史趋势与季节性预测下月净收入
playbooks.bizQuestion: 下个月大概能卖多少？

steps.title: 近 12 月收入趋势基线
steps.desc: 提取近 12 个月净收入，识别趋势与季节性。
steps.sql:
SELECT month, net_revenue, order_count,
    ROUND(net_revenue / NULLIF(order_count, 0), 2) AS aov
FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 13 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month;
steps.judge: 近 3 月均值作为基线；大促月单独标注

steps.title: 移动平均与环比增速
steps.desc: 计算 3 月移动平均与近期增速，作为预测输入。
steps.sql:
SELECT month, net_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS ma3,
    ROUND((net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))
          / NULLIF(LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) * 100, 2) AS mom_pct
FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 13 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 6;
steps.judge: MA3 与最新月偏差 > 15% → 考虑结构性变化

steps.title: 日度近期动量修正
steps.desc: 用近 30 日日均收入修正月度预测。
steps.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(daily_rev), 2) AS avg_daily_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(daily_rev) * DAY(LAST_DAY(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))), 2) AS projected_next_month
FROM (
    SELECT snapshot_date AS date_id, SUM(revenue) AS daily_rev FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
    GROUP BY snapshot_date) t;
steps.judge: 日度动量与 MA3 取加权平均（日度 40% + MA3 60%）

steps.title: 情景区间估算
steps.desc: 基于历史波动率给出乐观/基准/悲观区间。
steps.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(net_revenue), 2) AS avg_rev,
    ROUND(STDDEV(net_revenue), 2) AS std_rev,
    ROUND(AVG(net_revenue) - STDDEV(net_revenue), 2) AS pessimistic,
    ROUND(AVG(net_revenue) + STDDEV(net_revenue), 2) AS optimistic
FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH), '%Y-%m');
steps.judge: 区间宽度 > 20% 均值 → 预测不确定性高，需标注

outputs: 下月收入预测报告（点预测+区间）
nextSteps: 预测低于目标 → 「年底目标达成预测」
品类拆分 → 「下季度品牌/品类收入预测」
现金规划 → 「资金缺口预测」

playbooks.title: 下季度品牌/品类收入预测
playbooks.desc: 按品牌与品类分解的下季度收入预测
playbooks.bizQuestion: 下季度各品牌/品类分别能卖多少？
triggers: 季度经营计划与订货会

steps.title: 品牌近 4 季度收入基线
steps.desc: 按品牌汇总近 4 个季度收入趋势。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.brand_name, QUARTER(STR_TO_DATE(CAST(DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m')*100+1 AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d')) AS qtr,
    YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(CAST(DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m')*100+1 AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d')) AS yr,
    SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 15 MONTH), '%Y%m%d') + 0 AND s.brand_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.brand_name, yr, qtr ORDER BY s.brand_name, yr, qtr;
steps.judge: 季节性品牌（如户外）需按同季度去年基准

steps.title: 品类结构与增速
steps.desc: 各品类近 2 季度增速与占比。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(s.revenue) / SUM(SUM(s.revenue)) OVER () * 100, 2) AS share_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY i.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
steps.judge: 高占比低增速品类 → 保守预测

steps.title: 品牌×品类交叉预测
steps.desc: 主力品牌-品类组合下季度预测分解。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.brand_name, s.category_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue_6m
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s


WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY s.brand_name, s.category_name ORDER BY revenue_6m DESC LIMIT 30;
steps.judge: TOP20 组合贡献应覆盖 > 80% 预测额

steps.title: 汇总至季度总量
steps.desc: 加总各品牌/品类预测并与整体季度目标对比。
steps.sql:
SELECT SUM(revenue) AS last_q_revenue FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m');
steps.judge: 预测总量 vs 季度目标差距 > 10% → 预警

outputs: 下季度品牌/品类收入预测表
nextSteps: 总量缺口 → 「年底目标达成预测」
品类滞销风险 → 「库存清仓优化」
品牌资源 → 「预算分配优化」

playbooks.title: 年底目标达成预测
playbooks.desc: 基于 YTD 进度预测全年目标能否达成
playbooks.bizQuestion: 年底目标还能完成吗？差多少？
triggers: YTD 达成率落后时间进度

steps.title: YTD 收入与目标进度
steps.desc: 计算年初至今累计收入与时间进度对比。
steps.judge: YTD 达成率 < 时间进度 - 5ppt → 黄色预警

steps.title: 剩余月份所需月均
steps.desc: 倒算达成全年目标所需剩余月均收入。
steps.sql:
WITH ytd AS (
    SELECT SUM(revenue) AS ytd_rev FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
    WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01-01')), '%Y-%m')),
target AS (SELECT 120000000.0 AS annual_target)
SELECT ytd.ytd_rev, t.annual_target, t.annual_target - ytd.ytd_rev AS gap,
    ROUND((t.annual_target - ytd.ytd_rev) / (12 - MONTH(CURDATE()) + 1), 2) AS required_monthly_avg
FROM ytd, target t;
steps.judge: 所需月均 > 历史最高月 120% → 红色预警

steps.title: 按品牌分解缺口
steps.desc: 各品牌 YTD 与预算目标对比。
steps.sql:
SELECT brand_name, SUM(revenue) AS ytd_revenue, SUM(net_profit) AS ytd_profit
FROM (SELECT s.snapshot_month, s.brand_name, s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit, SUM(IFNULL(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS operating_expense, SUM(s.profit) - SUM(IFNULL(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS net_profit FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly s LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e ON s.snapshot_month = e.snapshot_month AND s.brand_name = e.brand_name AND s.channel_name = e.channel_name GROUP BY s.snapshot_month, s.brand_name, s.channel_name) v_income_statement
WHERE snapshot_month >= CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01')
GROUP BY brand_name ORDER BY ytd_revenue DESC;
steps.judge: 主力品牌缺口 > 全年目标 30% → 专项追赶计划

steps.title: 趋势外推全年预测
steps.desc: 用 YTD 月均 × 12 或趋势修正预测全年。
steps.sql:
SELECT month, net_revenue FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01-01')), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;
steps.judge: 线性外推 vs 季节性外推取保守值

outputs: 年底目标达成预测报告
缺口分解（整体/品牌/渠道）
nextSteps: 缺口大 → 「预算分配优化」+ 「营销费用优化」
增长乏力 → 「收入增长缓慢诊断」
资金吃紧 → 「资金缺口预测」

playbooks.title: 资金缺口预测
playbooks.desc: 预测未来 3-6 个月现金流缺口
playbooks.bizQuestion: 未来会不会缺钱？缺口有多大？

steps.title: 当前现金与近 30 日净流
steps.desc: 评估现有现金缓冲与近期净流出趋势。
steps.sql:
SELECT SUM(net_cashflow) AS net_cf_30d, SUM(inflow_amount) AS inflow_30d,
    SUM(outflow_amount) AS outflow_30d
FROM (SELECT payment_date AS snapshot_date, SUM(payment_amount) AS inflow_amount, 0 AS outflow_amount, SUM(payment_amount) AS net_cashflow FROM retail_finance.ods_payment GROUP BY payment_date) cf
WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0;
steps.judge: 30 日净流出 > 现金储备 20% → 橙色预警

steps.title: 月度经营现金流趋势
steps.desc: 从现金流量表视图看历史月度经营现金流。
steps.sql:
SELECT snapshot_month, SUM(operating_cashflow) AS op_cf, SUM(net_profit) AS net_profit
FROM retail_finance.v_cashflow
WHERE snapshot_month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY snapshot_month ORDER BY snapshot_month;
steps.judge: 经营现金流连续 2 月为负 → 高缺口风险

steps.title: 未来支出承诺（采购+费用）
steps.desc: 估算未来采购入库与预算费用现金需求。
steps.judge: 剩余预算 + 采购承诺 > 预测现金流入 → 缺口

steps.title: 缺口情景与融资建议
steps.desc: 综合流入预测与流出承诺，给出缺口区间。
steps.sql:
SELECT AVG(net_cashflow) AS avg_daily_cf FROM (SELECT payment_date AS snapshot_date, SUM(payment_amount) AS inflow_amount, 0 AS outflow_amount, SUM(payment_amount) AS net_cashflow FROM retail_finance.ods_payment GROUP BY payment_date) cf
WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0;
steps.judge: 预测 90 日累计缺口 > 0 → 启动融资/去库存方案

nextSteps: 库存占现金 → 「库存清仓优化」
利润现金背离 → 「净现比下降诊断」
控费 → 「营销费用优化」

playbooks.title: 渠道ROI持续下降预警
playbooks.desc: 监测各渠道广告 ROI 持续恶化趋势
playbooks.bizQuestion: 哪个渠道投放越来越不划算？
triggers: 渠道 ROI 连续 3 月下降
广告费升但渠道收入降

steps.title: 渠道月度 ROI 趋势
steps.desc: 计算各渠道近 6 月广告投入产出比趋势。
steps.sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.ad_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, a.channel_name,
    SUM(a.ad_spend) AS ad_spend,
    (SELECT SUM(s.revenue) FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s
     
     WHERE s.channel_name = a.channel_name
       AND DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(a.ad_date, '%Y%m') + 0) AS channel_revenue,
    ROUND((SELECT SUM(s.revenue) FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s
     
     WHERE s.channel_name = a.channel_name
       AND DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(a.ad_date, '%Y%m') + 0)
     / NULLIF(SUM(a.ad_spend), 0), 2) AS roi
FROM retail_finance.ods_ad_cost a
WHERE a.ad_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
GROUP BY month, a.channel_name ORDER BY a.channel_name, month;
steps.judge: ROI 连续 3 月下降且 < 3 → 红色预警

steps.title: 广告费增速 vs 收入增速
steps.desc: 对比各渠道广告费与收入增速背离。
steps.sql:
SELECT channel_name, SUM(ad_spend) AS ad_spend_3m FROM retail_finance.ods_ad_cost
WHERE ad_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY channel_name;
steps.judge: 广告费增速 > 收入增速 2 倍 → 效率恶化

steps.title: 渠道费用率联动
steps.desc: 结合渠道费用率看 ROI 下降的结构性原因。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.channel_name, SUM(e.expense_amount) AS expense, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(e.expense_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS expense_rate_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s

LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e ON s.channel_name = e.channel_name AND DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = e.snapshot_month
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY s.channel_name;
steps.judge: 费用率升 + ROI 降 → 双重预警

steps.title: 预警清单与减投建议
steps.desc: 汇总持续下降渠道并给出减投/暂停建议。
steps.sql:
SELECT channel_name, SUM(ad_spend) AS total_spend,
    ROUND(SUM(ad_spend) / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(ad_date, '%Y-%m')), 2) AS avg_monthly_spend
FROM retail_finance.ods_ad_cost WHERE ad_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
GROUP BY channel_name ORDER BY total_spend DESC;
steps.judge: ROI < 2 且趋势下降 → 建议减投 30% 或暂停

outputs: 渠道 ROI 持续下降预警报告
nextSteps: 评估减投影响 → 「渠道投入产出评估」
优化投放 → 「营销费用优化」
活动复盘 → 「营销活动ROI评估」

playbooks.title: 营销活动ROI评估
playbooks.desc: 评估单次营销活动投入产出
playbooks.bizQuestion: 这场活动值不值得？ROI 多少？
triggers: 大促/品牌日活动结束后
新营销方案上线 2 周后
市场部申请追加预算前

steps.title: 活动期收入与订单增量
steps.desc: 对比活动期与基线期的收入、订单变化。
steps.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date BETWEEN 20250601 AND 20250618 THEN net_revenue END) AS promo_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date BETWEEN 20250514 AND 20250531 THEN net_revenue END) AS baseline_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date BETWEEN 20250601 AND 20250618 THEN order_count END) AS promo_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date BETWEEN 20250514 AND 20250531 THEN order_count END) AS baseline_orders
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily;
steps.judge: 增量收入 = 活动期 - 基线期（同天数）

steps.title: 活动广告与促销费用
steps.desc: 汇总活动期间广告费与促销让利成本。
steps.sql:
SELECT SUM(ad_spend) AS ad_cost FROM retail_finance.ods_ad_cost
WHERE ad_date BETWEEN '2025-06-01' AND '2025-06-18';
steps.judge: 总投入 = 广告费 + 促销让利 + 额外人力/物料

steps.title: ROI 与增量利润率
steps.desc: 计算 ROI 与增量毛利。
steps.sql:
SELECT SUM(profit) AS promo_gross_profit FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily
WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN 20250601 AND 20250618;
steps.judge: ROI = 增量毛利 / 总投入；ROI < 1 → 亏损活动
steps.output: 活动 ROI 与盈亏结论

steps.title: 渠道/品类活动效果分解
steps.desc: 活动效果在各渠道、品类的分布。
steps.judge: 80% 增量来自单一渠道 → 活动偏科

outputs: 营销活动 ROI 评估报告
nextSteps: ROI 低 → 「营销费用优化」
渠道偏科 → 「渠道投入产出评估」
折扣过度 → 「折扣策略优化」

playbooks.title: 渠道投入产出评估
playbooks.desc: 综合评估各渠道投入与产出效率
playbooks.bizQuestion: 这个渠道还值得继续投吗？
triggers: 年度/季度渠道策略复盘
平台佣金或广告费上涨
新渠道试点满 3 个月

steps.title: 渠道收入毛利与份额
steps.desc: 各渠道近 3 月收入、毛利、占比。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit,
    ROUND(SUM(s.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY s.channel_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
steps.judge: 收入高但毛利低 → 需结合费用评估

steps.title: 渠道全口径投入
steps.desc: 广告费 + 平台费用 + 运营费用。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.channel_name, IFNULL(SUM(e.expense_amount), 0) AS channel_expense,
    IFNULL(SUM(a.ad_spend), 0) AS ad_spend
FROM retail_finance.dim_channel c
LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e ON c.channel_id = e.channel_id
    AND e.snapshot_month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
LEFT JOIN retail_finance.ods_ad_cost a ON a.channel_name = s.channel_name
    AND a.ad_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
GROUP BY s.channel_name;
steps.judge: 全口径投入 = 广告 + 平台佣金 + 运营人力分摊

steps.title: 渠道净利润贡献估算
steps.desc: 产出毛利减全口径投入得渠道贡献。
steps.sql:
SELECT brand_name, channel_name, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(net_profit) AS net_profit
FROM (SELECT s.snapshot_month, s.brand_name, s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit, SUM(IFNULL(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS operating_expense, SUM(s.profit) - SUM(IFNULL(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS net_profit FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly s LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e ON s.snapshot_month = e.snapshot_month AND s.brand_name = e.brand_name AND s.channel_name = e.channel_name GROUP BY s.snapshot_month, s.brand_name, s.channel_name) v_income_statement
WHERE snapshot_month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY brand_name, channel_name ORDER BY net_profit DESC LIMIT 20;
steps.judge: 净贡献为负的渠道 → 关停/减投候选

steps.title: 投入产出比与决策建议
steps.desc: 汇总 ROI 并给出加投/维持/减投建议。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.channel_name,
    ROUND(SUM(s.revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(e.expense_amount), 0), 2) AS revenue_per_expense
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s

LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e ON s.channel_name = e.channel_name AND DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = e.snapshot_month
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY s.channel_name ORDER BY revenue_per_expense DESC;
steps.judge: 产出/投入 < 3 → 减投；> 5 → 可加投

outputs: 渠道投入产出评估报告
nextSteps: ROI 持续降 → 「渠道ROI持续下降预警」
减投方案 → 「营销费用优化」
线下店 → 「门店关停评估」

playbooks.title: 促销活动效果评估
playbooks.desc: 评估折扣促销对销量、毛利与客单的影响
playbooks.bizQuestion: 这次促销拉动了多少销量？有没有亏毛利？
triggers: 常态化折扣活动月度复盘

steps.title: 促销期 vs 非促销期对比
steps.desc: 对比促销期与非促销期的销量、收入、毛利。
steps.sql:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date BETWEEN 20250601 AND 20250618 THEN net_revenue END) AS promo_rev,
    SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date NOT BETWEEN 20250601 AND 20250618
        AND date_id >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y%m%d') + 0 THEN net_revenue END) AS non_promo_rev,
    SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date BETWEEN 20250601 AND 20250618 THEN gross_profit END) AS promo_gp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date BETWEEN 20250601 AND 20250618 THEN order_count END) AS promo_orders
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m');
steps.judge: 促销期日均订单 > 非促销 150% → 有效拉量

steps.title: 客单价与折扣深度
steps.desc: 分析促销期客单价变化与折扣力度。
steps.judge: AOV 降 > 20% 且毛利降 → 过度折扣

steps.title: 品类/品牌促销响应
steps.desc: 哪些品类/品牌对促销响应最好。
steps.judge: 高响应低毛利品类 → 限制促销深度

steps.title: 促销后回落（透支）检测
steps.desc: 促销结束后 7 日销量是否明显回落。
steps.sql:
SELECT snapshot_date AS date_id, SUM(revenue) AS daily_rev FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily
WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN 20250619 AND 20250630 GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY snapshot_date;
steps.judge: 促销后 7 日均 < 促销前 7 日均 → 存在需求透支

outputs: 促销活动效果评估报告
nextSteps: 过度折扣 → 「折扣策略优化」
定价问题 → 「定价优化分析」
活动 ROI → 「营销活动ROI评估」

playbooks.title: 门店关停评估
playbooks.desc: 评估低效门店是否应关停或整改
playbooks.bizQuestion: 这家店要不要关？关了能省多少钱？

steps.title: 门店近 90 日经营表现
steps.desc: 收入、利润、坪效、排名。
steps.sql:
SELECT store_id, store_name, region, SUM(daily_revenue) AS rev_90d, SUM(daily_profit) AS profit_90d,
    ROUND(SUM(daily_revenue) / NULLIF(MAX(store_area), 0), 2) AS pingxiao,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(daily_profit) ASC) AS profit_rank
FROM retail_finance.dws_store_daily
WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY store_id, store_name, region ORDER BY profit_90d ASC LIMIT 20;
steps.judge: 连续 90 日亏损且坪效后 20% → 关停候选

steps.title: 门店 vs 区域均值
steps.desc: 对比区域平均坪效与利润率。
steps.sql:
WITH store AS (
    SELECT store_id, region, SUM(daily_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(daily_revenue), 0) AS profit_rate
    FROM retail_finance.dws_store_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
    GROUP BY store_id, region),
region AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(profit_rate) AS avg_profit_rate FROM store GROUP BY region)
SELECT s.store_id, s.region, s.profit_rate, r.avg_profit_rate
FROM store s INNER JOIN region r ON s.region = r.region ORDER BY s.profit_rate ASC;
steps.judge: 利润率 < 区域均值 50% → 显著落后

steps.title: 关停成本与节省估算
steps.desc: 估算关停后可节省的租金、人力、运营成本。
steps.sql:
SELECT store_id, store_name, SUM(daily_revenue) AS rev, SUM(daily_profit) AS profit
FROM retail_finance.dws_store_daily
WHERE store_id = 'S001' AND date_id >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY store_id, store_name;
steps.judge: 关停节省 = 固定成本 - 损失毛利（若有客户转移则调整）

steps.title: 客户转移与收入影响
steps.desc: 评估关停后周边门店能否承接客流。
steps.sql:
SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS store_cnt, SUM(daily_revenue) AS region_rev
FROM retail_finance.dws_store_daily
WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY region;
steps.judge: 区域门店密度高 → 客户转移率高，关停影响小

nextSteps: 区域整体下滑 → 「收入下滑诊断」
资源重配 → 「预算分配优化」
标杆复制 → 门店最佳实践

playbooks.title: 供应商绩效评估
playbooks.desc: 评估供应商交付、质量与成本表现
playbooks.bizQuestion: 这个供应商表现怎么样？要不要换？
triggers: 退货率上升怀疑供货质量

steps.title: 采购订单交付准时率
steps.desc: 从采购 ODS 看订单与收货匹配情况。
steps.sql:
SELECT supplier_name, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN receipt_date <= expected_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN receipt_date <= expected_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS on_time_pct
FROM retail_finance.ods_purchase_order po
LEFT JOIN retail_finance.ods_purchase_receipt pr ON po.po_id = pr.po_id
WHERE po.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
GROUP BY supplier_name ORDER BY on_time_pct ASC;
steps.judge: 准时率 < 85% → 交付风险

steps.title: 采购成本与退货关联
steps.desc: 关联供应商供货品类退货率。
steps.sql:
SELECT po.supplier_name, SUM(pr.receipt_amount) AS receipt_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.receipt_id) AS receipt_cnt
FROM retail_finance.ods_purchase_receipt pr
INNER JOIN retail_finance.ods_purchase_order po ON pr.po_id = po.po_id
WHERE pr.receipt_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
GROUP BY po.supplier_name ORDER BY receipt_amt DESC;
steps.judge: 高采购额 + 高退货品类 → 质量风险

steps.title: 采购价趋势
steps.desc: 分析主要供应商采购金额与单价趋势。
steps.sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(receipt_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, supplier_name,
    SUM(receipt_amount) AS monthly_receipt
FROM retail_finance.ods_purchase_receipt pr
INNER JOIN retail_finance.ods_purchase_order po ON pr.po_id = po.po_id
WHERE receipt_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
GROUP BY month, supplier_name ORDER BY supplier_name, month;
steps.judge: 采购价升 > 5% 且毛利降 → 议价或换供

steps.title: 综合评分与淘汰建议
steps.desc: 交付、质量、成本、响应综合打分。
steps.sql:
SELECT supplier_name, SUM(receipt_amount) AS total_purchase
FROM retail_finance.ods_purchase_receipt pr
INNER JOIN retail_finance.ods_purchase_order po ON pr.po_id = po.po_id
WHERE receipt_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
GROUP BY supplier_name ORDER BY total_purchase DESC;
steps.judge: 综合评分后 20% 且非战略供应商 → 淘汰候选

nextSteps: 成本问题 → 「毛利率下滑诊断」
库存积压 → 「库存周转天数上升诊断」
新品 → 「新品表现评估」

playbooks.title: 新品表现评估
playbooks.desc: 评估新品上市后的销售、毛利与库存表现
playbooks.bizQuestion: 新品卖得好不好？要不要追单/下架？

steps.title: 新品销售与动销
steps.desc: 从订单事实表筛选新品 SKU 的销售表现。
steps.sql:
SELECT brand, category, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders, SUM(payment_amount) AS revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN return_flag = 0 THEN payment_amount - cost ELSE 0 END) AS gross_profit
FROM retail_finance.dwd_sales_wide
WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND product_tag = '新品'
GROUP BY brand, category ORDER BY revenue DESC;
steps.judge: 上市 4 周销量 < 预期 50% → 预警

steps.title: 新品毛利率与退货
steps.desc: 评估新品盈利质量与退货率。
steps.sql:
SELECT brand, category,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN return_flag = 0 THEN payment_amount - cost ELSE 0 END)
          / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN return_flag = 0 THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN return_flag = 1 THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END)
          / NULLIF(SUM(payment_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate
FROM retail_finance.dwd_sales_wide
WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND product_tag = '新品'
GROUP BY brand, category;
steps.judge: 退货率 > 15% → 查品控与定位

steps.title: 新品库存与周转
steps.desc: 新品库存占用与周转情况。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name, SUM(i.stock_amount) AS inv_cost, AVG(i.turnover_days) AS turnover
FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily i

WHERE DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily)
  AND i.product_tag = '新品'
GROUP BY i.category_name;
steps.judge: 动销慢 + 库存高 → 降价或下架

steps.title: 追单/下架决策
steps.desc: 综合销售、毛利、库存给出追单或清仓建议。
steps.sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%u') AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS weekly_orders
FROM retail_finance.dwd_sales_wide
WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 WEEK) AND product_tag = '新品'
GROUP BY week ORDER BY week;
steps.judge: 周销趋势上升 + 毛利 OK → 追单；趋势降 → 下架

outputs: 追单/下架/加大推广建议
nextSteps: 滞销 → 「库存清仓优化」
定价不当 → 「定价优化分析」
供应商 → 「供应商绩效评估」

playbooks.title: 预算分配优化
playbooks.desc: 基于 ROI 与战略优先级优化预算分配
playbooks.bizQuestion: 下季度预算应该怎么分？
triggers: 某渠道/品牌 ROI 显著变化

steps.title: 当前预算执行与产出
steps.desc: 各费用科目/品牌/渠道预算执行与产出对比。
steps.sql:
SELECT b.expense_type, SUM(b.budget_amount) AS budget, SUM(b.expense_amount) AS actual,
    ROUND(SUM(b.expense_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(b.budget_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS usage_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly b
INNER JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly b ON 1=1
WHERE b.snapshot_month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY b.expense_type ORDER BY usage_pct DESC;
steps.judge: 执行率低且产出高 → 可加配；执行率高且产出低 → 减配

steps.title: 品牌/渠道 ROI 排名
steps.desc: 识别高 ROI 与低 ROI 维度，指导资源倾斜。
steps.sql:
SELECT brand_name, channel_name, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(net_profit) AS net_profit,
    ROUND(SUM(net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS net_margin
FROM (SELECT s.snapshot_month, s.brand_name, s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit, SUM(IFNULL(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS operating_expense, SUM(s.profit) - SUM(IFNULL(e.expense_amount, 0)) AS net_profit FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly s LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e ON s.snapshot_month = e.snapshot_month AND s.brand_name = e.brand_name AND s.channel_name = e.channel_name GROUP BY s.snapshot_month, s.brand_name, s.channel_name) v_income_statement
WHERE snapshot_month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY brand_name, channel_name ORDER BY net_margin DESC LIMIT 20;
steps.judge: 高 ROI 组合预算增幅 10-20%；低 ROI 减 20-30%

steps.title: 战略优先级加权
steps.desc: 结合战略（新品牌、新渠道）对 ROI 排名加权调整。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.brand_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue,
    SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY s.brand_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
steps.judge: 战略品牌可容忍 ROI 低于均值 1 个季度

steps.title: 输出优化后预算方案
steps.desc: 汇总各维度建议预算额与调整幅度。
steps.sql:
SELECT expense_type_id, SUM(budget_amount) AS cur_budget, SUM(payment_amount) AS cur_actual
FROM retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly
WHERE snapshot_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY expense_type_id;
steps.judge: 总预算不变前提下重新分配；若需增总预算需单独审批

nextSteps: 营销预算 → 「营销费用优化」
渠道调整 → 「渠道投入产出评估」
目标对齐 → 「年底目标达成预测」

playbooks.title: 营销费用优化
playbooks.desc: 在收入目标下优化营销费用结构与效率
playbooks.bizQuestion: 营销费怎么花更划算？

steps.title: 营销费用结构与占比
steps.desc: 分解广告、平台、促销等营销费用占比。
steps.sql:
SELECT b.expense_type, SUM(b.expense_amount) AS actual
FROM retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly b
INNER JOIN retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly b ON 1=1
WHERE b.expense_type LIKE '%营销%' OR b.expense_type LIKE '%广告%'
  AND b.snapshot_month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY b.expense_type ORDER BY actual DESC;
steps.judge: 单一科目占比 > 60% → 结构过于集中

steps.title: 各渠道广告 ROI
steps.desc: 识别高效与低效投放渠道。
steps.sql:
SELECT a.channel_name, SUM(a.ad_spend) AS spend,
    ROUND(SUM(s.revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(a.ad_spend), 0), 2) AS roi
FROM retail_finance.ods_ad_cost a
LEFT JOIN retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s ON a.channel_name = (
    SELECT channel_name FROM retail_finance.dim_channel WHERE channel_id = s.channel_id LIMIT 1)
    AND DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(a.ad_date, '%Y%m') + 0
WHERE a.ad_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
GROUP BY a.channel_name ORDER BY roi DESC;
steps.judge: ROI < 2 渠道减投 30%；ROI > 5 可加投 15%

steps.title: 营销费用率 vs 收入弹性
steps.desc: 分析营销费增减对收入的边际影响。
steps.sql:
SELECT e.snapshot_month, SUM(e.expense_amount) AS marketing_expense,
    (SELECT net_revenue FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总） ms
     WHERE REPLACE(ms.month, '-', '') = CAST(e.snapshot_month AS CHAR)) AS revenue
FROM retail_finance.dws_expense_monthly e
WHERE e.expense_type_id IN (SELECT expense_type_id FROM retail_finance.dim_expense_type
    WHERE expense_type LIKE '%营销%')
  AND e.snapshot_month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY e.snapshot_month ORDER BY e.snapshot_month;
steps.judge: 费用增但收入不增 → 边际效益递减

steps.title: 优化方案与预期节省
steps.desc: 汇总减投/换投方案及预期节省与收入影响。
steps.sql:
SELECT channel_name, SUM(ad_spend) AS total_spend,
    ROUND(AVG(ad_spend), 2) AS avg_daily_spend
FROM retail_finance.ods_ad_cost WHERE ad_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
GROUP BY channel_name ORDER BY total_spend DESC;
steps.judge: 目标：营销费用率降 2ppt 且收入不降 > 3%

nextSteps: 渠道决策 → 「渠道投入产出评估」
活动复盘 → 「营销活动ROI评估」
预警 → 「渠道ROI持续下降预警」

playbooks.title: 定价优化分析
playbooks.desc: 基于弹性与竞品分析优化定价
playbooks.bizQuestion: 价格定高了还是低了？怎么调价？

steps.title: 品类价格带与销量分布
steps.desc: 分析各价格带销量与毛利贡献。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name,
    ROUND(SUM(s.revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(s.order_count), 0), 2) AS avg_price,
    SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.profit) AS gross_profit,
    ROUND(SUM(s.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY i.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
steps.judge: 高价格带销量低但毛利高 → 可维持；低价格带走量但毛利低 → 提价或降本

steps.title: 品牌/品类毛利率 vs 销量
steps.desc: 识别定价过高（销量低毛利高）或过低（销量高毛利低）。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.brand_name, s.category_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue,
    SUM(s.order_count) AS orders, SUM(s.profit) AS gp
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s


WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY s.brand_name, s.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 30;
steps.judge: 毛利 > 50% 但订单 < 中位数 → 可能定价过高

steps.title: 渠道价差分析
steps.desc: 同一商品在不同渠道的实付价差异。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.channel_name, ROUND(SUM(s.revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(s.order_count), 0), 2) AS channel_aov,
    ROUND(SUM(s.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY s.channel_name;
steps.judge: 渠道价差 > 15% → 需统一定价策略

steps.title: 调价建议与影响测算
steps.desc: 给出具体调价建议及收入/毛利影响估算。
steps.sql:
SELECT month, gross_margin_pct, net_revenue FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;
steps.judge: 提价 3-5% 需评估销量弹性；降价需确保增量 > 毛利损失

nextSteps: 促销配合 → 「折扣策略优化」
毛利影响 → 「毛利率下滑诊断」
竞品应对 → 「促销活动效果评估」

playbooks.title: 折扣策略优化
playbooks.desc: 优化折扣深度、频率与品类范围
playbooks.bizQuestion: 折扣怎么打才能既走量又不亏？

steps.title: 历史折扣与销量/毛利关系
steps.desc: 分析不同折扣深度下的销量与毛利表现。
steps.sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') AS snapshot_month,
    ROUND(SUM(gmv) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0), 3) AS discount_index,
    SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily
WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY FLOOR(date_id/100) ORDER BY snapshot_month;
steps.judge: discount_index > 1.15 且毛利降 → 折扣过深

steps.title: 品类折扣敏感度
steps.desc: 哪些品类对折扣响应高、哪些低。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name,
    ROUND(SUM(s.gmv) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue), 0), 3) AS avg_discount,
    SUM(s.order_count) AS orders, SUM(s.profit) AS gp
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY i.category_name ORDER BY orders DESC;
steps.judge: 高敏感高毛利品类 → 适度折扣；低敏感 → 少折扣

steps.title: 促销频率与透支效应
steps.desc: 评估频繁促销是否透支需求。
steps.sql:
SELECT month, net_revenue, order_count FROM (SELECT snapshot_month AS month, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(revenue + return_amount) AS gmv, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue, SUM(profit) AS gross_profit, ROUND(SUM(profit) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM(return_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue + return_amount), 0) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_monthly GROUP BY snapshot_month) dws_sales_monthly（按月汇总）
WHERE month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;
steps.judge: 大促月后次月环比降 > 15% → 存在透支

steps.title: 优化后折扣策略
steps.desc: 输出品类折扣上限、促销频率与深度建议。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.channel_name, ROUND(SUM(s.gmv)/NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue),0), 3) AS discount_index,
    ROUND(SUM(s.profit)/NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue),0)*100, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY s.channel_name;
steps.judge: 建议：核心品类折扣 ≤ 15%，大促 ≤ 25%，频率 ≤ 2 次/月

nextSteps: 定价基础 → 「定价优化分析」
活动复盘 → 「促销活动效果评估」
毛利恢复 → 「毛利率下滑诊断」

playbooks.title: 库存清仓优化
playbooks.desc: 制定滞销库存清仓方案以回收现金
playbooks.bizQuestion: 滞销库存怎么清？打几折能清掉？
triggers: 资金缺口需快速回笼现金

steps.title: 识别滞销 SKU/品类
steps.desc: 高库存、低动销、长库龄品类清单。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name, SUM(i.stock_amount) AS inv_cost,
    ROUND(AVG(i.turnover_days), 1) AS turnover_days, SUM(i.qty_on_hand) AS qty
FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily i

WHERE DATE_FORMAT(i.snapshot_date, '%Y%m%d')+0 = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily)
GROUP BY i.category_name HAVING AVG(i.turnover_days) > 60
ORDER BY inv_cost DESC;
steps.judge: 周转 > 90 天且库存成本 TOP10 → 优先清仓

steps.title: 清仓折扣与销量弹性
steps.desc: 参考历史促销数据估算不同折扣下的清仓速度。
steps.sql:
SELECT i.category_name, SUM(s.order_count) AS orders, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(s.gmv)/NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue),0), 3) AS discount_level
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
  AND s.gmv > s.revenue
GROUP BY i.category_name ORDER BY orders DESC;
steps.judge: 每加深 10% 折扣，销量增约 30-50%（依品类）

steps.title: 清仓渠道选择
steps.desc: 选择Outlet、电商特卖、线下快闪等清仓渠道。
steps.sql:
SELECT s.channel_name, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(s.order_count) AS orders,
    ROUND(SUM(s.profit)/NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue),0)*100, 2) AS margin
FROM retail_finance.dws_sales_daily s 
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(s.snapshot_date, '%Y-%m') >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH), '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY s.channel_name ORDER BY orders DESC;
steps.judge: 高流量低毛利渠道适合清仓；线下 Outlet 适合鞋服

steps.title: 清仓方案与现金回收测算
steps.desc: 输出分阶段折扣计划与预计现金回收。
steps.judge: 目标 60 天内清掉 70% 滞销库存；接受毛利降至 5-10%
steps.output: 清仓方案与现金回收时间表

steps.title: 清仓后库存与周转监控
steps.desc: 设定清仓期 KPI 监控周转改善。
steps.sql:
SELECT snapshot_date AS date_id, SUM(stock_amount) AS inv, AVG(turnover_days) AS turnover
FROM retail_finance.dws_inventory_daily
WHERE snapshot_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y%m%d') + 0
GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY snapshot_date;
steps.judge: 周转天数周降 > 3 天 → 清仓有效

outputs: 分阶段折扣与渠道计划
nextSteps: 周转监控 → 「库存周转天数上升诊断」
现金改善 → 「净现比下降诊断」
减少进货 → 「供应商绩效评估」
